season.sr: Otvoreno tokom cele godine; pletna i ostrvo najlepši su od aprila do oktobra, a zimi vožnje idu ređe i kraće.
season.en: Open all year; the pletna boats and the island are at their best from April to October, with shorter, less frequent winter sailings.

tagline.sr: Jezero kao sa razglednice, sa ostrvom, drvenim čamcima i ravnom šetnjom bez ijedne stepenice.
tagline.en: A postcard lake with an island, wooden boats and a flat, step-free walk all the way around.

description.sr: Bled je alpsko jezero sa crkvicom na ostrvu, starim gradom na steni i 6 km dugom ravnom stazom oko vode. Za porodice s malom decom idealan je jer se sve vrti oko lagane šetnje, vožnje pletnom i sladoleda pored jezera. Nema gužve ni stresa — dan ovde prolazi sporo i predvidljivo, baš kako roditeljima mališana treba.
description.en: Bled is an Alpine lake with a tiny island church, a castle on a cliff and a flat 6 km path all the way around the water. It suits families with small children because everything is a gentle stroll, a pletna boat ride and an ice cream by the shore. There is no rush here — days pass slowly and predictably, exactly what parents of little ones need.

highlights.sr: Vožnja pletnom do ostrva i zvonjenje zvoncem želja u crkvici
highlights.en: Riding the pletna boat to the island and ringing the wishing bell in the little church

highlights.sr: Šetnja oko jezera (6 km) — ravna staza, idealna za kolica
highlights.en: The 6 km lakeside loop — flat and perfect for a pram

highlights.sr: Bledski grad i pogled na jezero sa visine
highlights.en: Bled Castle and the view over the lake from up high

highlights.sr: Igrališta i kupanje u jezeru leti
highlights.en: Playgrounds and swimming in the lake in summer

pros.sr: Ravna, asfaltirana staza oko celog jezera — kolica idu bez problema
pros.en: Flat, paved path all around the lake — a pram rolls the whole way

pros.sr: Sve je na dohvat ruke: jezero, grad, park i kafići na jednom mestu
pros.en: Everything is close together: lake, castle, park and cafés

pros.sr: Bezbedno i mirno, idealno za prvi porodični izlet u inostranstvo
pros.en: Safe and calm — a great first family trip abroad

cons.sr: Leti može biti prilično gužve, posebno oko glavne plaže i pristaništa
cons.en: Can get busy in summer, especially around the main beach and boat docks

cons.sr: Parking u centru je skup i teško se nalazi u sezoni
cons.en: Parking in the centre is pricey and hard to find in season

cons.sr: Bledski grad ima strme staze i stepenice — nije baš za kolica
cons.en: Bled Castle has steep paths and steps — not great for a pram

tip.sr: Krenite na krug oko jezera rano ujutru dok je mirno — a pletnu platite gotovinom vozaču, kartice se ne primaju.
tip.en: Do the lake loop early in the morning while it's quiet — and pay the pletna boatman in cash, cards aren't accepted.

mode.sr: autom ili taksijem, pa brodom iz Fažane
mode.en: car or taxi, then the park boat from Fažana

season.sr: Za individualne posetioce otvoreno od marta do decembra; januar i februar samo za najavljene grupe.
season.en: Open to individual visitors from March to December; January and February are reserved for pre-arranged groups.

tagline.sr: Zebre, slobodne paunove i plitko more na ostrvu koje se obilazi vozom.
tagline.en: Zebras, free-roaming peacocks and a shallow sea on an island toured by little train.

description.sr: Brijuni su nacionalni park od 14 ostrva kod Fažane u Istri, poznat po safari parku sa zebrama, slonovima i lamama koje deca obožavaju. Do Velog Brijuna se ide brodom, a ostrvo se obilazi turističkim vozom uz vodiča. Uz životinje, tu su i mirne uvalice sa plitkom, toplom vodom — idealno za najmlađe kupače.
description.en: Brijuni is a national park of 14 islands off Fažana in Istria, famous for a safari park with zebras, elephants and llamas that children love. You reach Veli Brijun by boat and tour the island on a small train with a guide. Beyond the animals there are calm, sheltered coves with shallow, warm water — perfect for the youngest swimmers.

highlights.sr: Vožnja turističkim vozom kroz safari park
highlights.en: The little train ride through the safari park

highlights.sr: Zebre, lame, slon i slobodni paunovi po celom ostrvu
highlights.en: Zebras, llamas, an elephant and peacocks wandering the island

highlights.sr: Kupanje u plitkim uvalama uz ostrvo
highlights.en: Swimming in the shallow coves around the island

highlights.sr: Stari Rim i Tita — dinozaurovski otisci i muzeji
highlights.en: Ancient Rome and Tito — dinosaur footprints and small museums

pros.sr: Životinje izbliza i bez velikog hodanja — sve ide vozom
pros.en: Animals up close without much walking — the train does the work

pros.sr: Sve je u jednoj karti: brod, voz, safari park i vodič
pros.en: One ticket covers it all: boat, train, safari park and guide

pros.sr: Plitko, mirno more idealno za prve kupačke korake
pros.en: Shallow, calm sea — ideal for a child's first paddles

cons.sr: Prilično skupo za porodicu — leti karta odraslih dostiže 50 evra
cons.en: Quite pricey for a family — adult tickets reach €50 in summer

cons.sr: Ceo obilazak je fiksni termin od četiri sata; kasniš, nema povraćaja
cons.en: The whole visit is a fixed four-hour slot; miss the boat and there's no refund

cons.sr: Leti velika gužva na brodovima, a hladovine na vozovima nema mnogo
cons.en: Crowded boats in summer, and little shade on the train

tip.sr: Rezervišite prvi jutarnji brod i ponesite kupaće — nakon voza ostaje vremena za kupanje u uvali.
tip.en: Book the first morning boat and pack swimwear — there's time for a swim in the cove after the train ride.

season.sr: Šarganska osmica vozi od aprila do oktobra; zimi miruje, dok Gold gondola radi cele godine.
season.en: The Šargan Eight runs April to October and rests in winter; the Gold Gondola operates all year round.

tagline.sr: Voz koji se penje u obliku osmice, pa najduža gondola na svetu.
tagline.en: A train that climbs in a figure of eight, then the world's longest gondola.

description.sr: Zlatibor i Mokra Gora su planinski duo koji malu decu osvaja vozovima i žičarama. Šarganska osmica je stara uskotračna pruga kojom parni voz pravi krug u obliku osmice kroz tunele i šume, a Gold gondola sa Zlatibora vodi na Tornik i nudi pogled na ceo kraj. Dodajte Drvengrad, drveno etno-selo Emira Kusturice, i imate vikend bez ijednog dosadnog trenutka.
description.en: Zlatibor and Mokra Gora are a mountain pair that win over small children with trains and cable cars. The Šargan Eight is a heritage narrow-gauge railway whose train loops in a figure of eight through tunnels and forest, while the Gold Gondola climbs from Zlatibor to Tornik with views over the whole region. Add Drvengrad, Emir Kusturica's wooden ethno-village, and you have a weekend with not a single dull moment.

highlights.sr: Vožnja Šarganskom osmicom kroz tunele i preko mostića
highlights.en: Riding the Šargan Eight through tunnels and over little bridges

highlights.sr: Gold gondola do Tornika — pogled koji oduzima dah
highlights.en: The Gold Gondola up to Tornik — a breath-taking view

highlights.sr: Drvengrad — drveno selo sa ulicama i igralištima
highlights.en: Drvengrad — a wooden village with lanes and play areas

highlights.sr: Šetnje i jezero Ribničko u podnožju gondole
highlights.en: Walks and Lake Ribničko at the foot of the gondola

pros.sr: Voz i gondola su prava avantura i za bebe u kolicima
pros.en: The train and gondola are a real adventure, even for babies in a pram

pros.sr: Svež planinski vazduh i mnogo zelenila leti
pros.en: Fresh mountain air and plenty of greenery in summer

pros.sr: Veoma povoljno — karte i hrana znatno jeftinije nego na moru
pros.en: Very affordable — tickets and food far cheaper than on the coast

cons.sr: Do Zlatibora se iz većine gradova putuje dugo, krivudavim putevima
cons.en: A long, winding drive from most cities

cons.sr: Vikendom i u sezoni Šarganska osmica se brzo rasproda
cons.en: The Šargan Eight sells out fast on weekends and in season

cons.sr: Drvengrad ima kaldrmu i uzbrdice — nije idealan za kolica
cons.en: Drvengrad is cobbled and hilly — not ideal for a pram

tip.sr: Karte za Šargansku osmicu kupite dan ranije ili rezervišite — u julu i avgustu za vikend često nema mesta.
tip.en: Buy Šargan Eight tickets a day ahead or book in advance — weekend seats often sell out in July and August.

season.sr: Grad je otvoren cele godine; Štrand kupalište radi od maja do kraja septembra, a Fruška gora je najlepša proleće–jesen.
season.en: The city is open all year; the Štrand beach runs May to late September, and Fruška Gora is at its best spring to autumn.

tagline.sr: Tvrđava nad Dunavom, peščana plaža i šume Fruške gore — sve bez ulaznice.
tagline.en: A fortress over the Danube, a sandy beach and the woods of Fruška Gora — all without a ticket.

description.sr: Novi Sad je grad koji se lako obilazi sa kolicima: ravne ulice, Dunavski park sa jezercem i Petrovaradinska tvrđava sa koje se vidi ceo grad. Leti je glavna atrakcija Štrand, peščana plaža na Dunavu sa plićakom i igralištima, a odmah iza grada su šume i manastiri Fruške gore. Sve je povoljno i gotovo sve besplatno, što ga čini odličnim izborom za porodični izlet iz Beograda.
description.en: Novi Sad is a city that's easy to cover with a pram: flat streets, Dunavski Park with its little lake, and Petrovaradin Fortress with a view over everything. In summer the star is Štrand, a sandy Danube beach with shallow water and playgrounds, while just behind the city lie the woods and monasteries of Fruška Gora. Almost everything is free and cheap, which makes it a superb family day out from Belgrade.

highlights.sr: Šetnja po Petrovaradinskoj tvrđavi i pogled na Dunav
highlights.en: Walking the Petrovaradin Fortress and the Danube view

highlights.sr: Štrand — peščana plaža sa plićakom i toboganima
highlights.en: Štrand — a sandy beach with shallow water and slides

highlights.sr: Dunavski park i vožnja čamčićem po jezercu
highlights.en: Dunavski Park and a little pedal-boat ride on its lake

highlights.sr: Izlet na Frušku goru — šetnje kroz šumu i piknik
highlights.en: A trip to Fruška Gora — forest walks and a picnic

pros.sr: Ravan grad, široke staze — kolicima se svuda prolazi
pros.en: A flat city with wide paths — a pram gets everywhere

pros.sr: Skoro sve besplatno: tvrđava, parkovi, plaža
pros.en: Almost everything free: the fortress, parks and beach

pros.sr: Blizu Beograda — sat vremena brzom saobraćajnicom
pros.en: Close to Belgrade — about an hour by motorway

cons.sr: Leti na Štrandu može biti velika gužva vikendom
cons.en: Štrand can get very crowded on summer weekends

cons.sr: Na tvrđavi leti nema dovoljno hladovine
cons.en: Little shade on the fortress in summer

cons.sr: Dunav nije za neplivače — decu držite u plićaku
cons.en: The Danube isn't for non-swimmers — keep children in the shallows

tip.sr: Dođite na Štrand radnim danom pre podne — tada je najprazniji, a plićak je najtopliji.
tip.en: Visit Štrand on a weekday morning — it's at its emptiest and the shallows are warmest.

season.sr: Grad je živ cele godine; Ada i Kalemegdan najlepši su od aprila do oktobra, a leti je u centru vruće.
season.en: The city lives all year; Ada and Kalemegdan are at their best April to October, and the centre gets hot in summer.

tagline.sr: Zoološki vrt na tvrđavi, jezero Ada i parkovi u kojima se može provesti ceo dan.
tagline.en: A zoo on the fortress, the lake at Ada and parks you can spend a whole day in.

description.sr: Beograd za najmlađe znači pre svega Kalemegdan — tvrđava, park i zoološki vrt na jednom mestu, gde deca trče slobodno dok vi gledate ušće Save u Dunav. Leti je tu i Ada Ciganlija, savsko jezero sa plićacima, igralištima i biciklističkim stazama. Uz to, mnogi muzeji su besplatni prvih dana, a hrana i taksi su među najpovoljnijima u Evropi.
description.en: For little ones, Belgrade means Kalemegdan above all — a fortress, park and zoo in one spot, where children run free while you watch the Sava meet the Danube. In summer there's Ada Ciganlija, a lake with shallow swimming areas, playgrounds and cycle paths. Many museums are free on certain days, and food and taxis are among the cheapest in Europe.

highlights.sr: Zoološki vrt na Kalemegdanu — beli lavovi i pingvini
highlights.en: The Kalemegdan zoo — white lions and penguins

highlights.sr: Kalemegdanska tvrđava i park sa pogledom na reke
highlights.en: The fortress and park with views over the rivers

highlights.sr: Ada Ciganlija — kupanje, igrališta i vožnja biciklom
highlights.en: Ada Ciganlija — swimming, playgrounds and cycling

highlights.sr: Vožnja brodićem Savom i Dunavom
highlights.en: A little boat ride on the Sava and Danube

pros.sr: Jeftino — ulazi, hrana i smeštaj su među najnižima u Evropi
pros.en: Cheap — entry, food and stays are among the lowest in Europe

pros.sr: Kalemegdan spaja zoo, park i tvrđavu u jedan dan
pros.en: Kalemegdan packs zoo, park and fortress into one day

pros.sr: Ada nudi plićak i hladovinu — pravo mesto za vrele dane
pros.en: Ada offers shallows and shade — the right spot for hot days

cons.sr: Jul i avgust u gradu su vrući i teški za bebe
cons.en: July and August are hot and hard on babies in the city

cons.sr: Kalemegdan ima kaldrmu i uzbrdice — kolica idu sporije
cons.en: Kalemegdan has cobbles and slopes — prams go slowly

cons.sr: Vikendom su zoo i Ada prepuni
cons.en: The zoo and Ada are packed at weekends

tip.sr: Dođite na Adu radnim danom pre podne — plićak je prazan, a parking na Novom Beogradu besplatan.
tip.en: Head to Ada on a weekday morning — the shallows are empty and parking is free.

season.sr: Palić je najživlji od maja do septembra; zoo radi cele godine, a zimi su šetnje uz jezero mirne.
season.en: Palić is liveliest from May to September; the zoo runs all year and winter lakeside walks are peaceful.

tagline.sr: Jezero, zoološki vrt i grad secesije — miran vikend na severu Bačke.
tagline.en: A lake, a zoo and an Art-Nouveau town — a calm weekend in northern Bačka.

description.sr: Palić je jezero nadomak Subotice sa šetnicom, cvećem i zoološkim vrtom koji je pravi hit kod mališana — zveri, ptice i mali kontaktni kutak. Subotica je odmah pored: grad prelepih secesijskih fasada, sinagoge i parkova, sve na pet minuta jedan od drugog. Za porodice s malom decom ovo je opuštajuća, povoljna destinacija bez gužvi velikih gradova.
description.en: Palić is a lake just outside Subotica with a promenade, flowers and a zoo that's a real hit with little ones — big cats, birds and a small petting corner. Subotica is right next door: a town of beautiful Art-Nouveau façades, a synagogue and parks, all minutes apart. For families with small children it's a relaxed, affordable escape without big-city crowds.

highlights.sr: Zoološki vrt Palić — lavovi, majmuni i ptice
highlights.en: Palić Zoo — lions, monkeys and birds

highlights.sr: Šetnja oko jezera i vožnja čamcem
highlights.en: A walk around the lake and a boat ride

highlights.sr: Secesijske fasade Subotice i gradska kuća
highlights.en: Subotica's Art-Nouveau façades and town hall

highlights.sr: Igrališta i sladoled uz jezero
highlights.en: Playgrounds and ice cream by the lake

pros.en: A flat lakeside walk, ideal for prams and running

pros.sr: Vrlo povoljno — ulazi, hrana i smeštaj su jeftini
pros.en: Very affordable — entry, food and stays are cheap

pros.sr: Malo gužvi i miran ritam čak i u sezoni
pros.en: Few crowds and a calm pace even in season

cons.sr: Leti se jezero ne preporučuje za kupanje zbog vode
cons.en: The lake isn't recommended for swimming in summer

cons.sr: Manje sadržaja po kišnom vremenu
cons.en: Less to do on rainy days

cons.en: Around a two-hour drive from Belgrade

tip.sr: Kombinujte zoo ujutru i Suboticu popodne — sve je na deset minuta kolima, a parking uz jezero je besplatan.
tip.en: Do the zoo in the morning and Subotica in the afternoon — everything is ten minutes by car and lakeside parking is free.

season.sr: Park je otvoren cele godine; leti radi do 20h, zimi do 16h, a neke staze zimi budu zatvorene.
season.en: The park is open all year; summer hours run to 8pm, winter to 4pm, and some paths close in winter.

tagline.sr: Šesnaest jezera i na stotine vodopada — najlepša šetnja koju će dete zapamtiti.
tagline.en: Sixteen lakes and hundreds of waterfalls — the most beautiful walk a child will remember.

description.sr: Plitvička jezera su najpoznatiji nacionalni park u regionu — tirkizna jezera koja se prelivaju jedno u drugo preko bezbroj vodopada, a kroz park vode drvene staze tik iznad vode. Za decu je ovo prava bajka: električni čamčići po jezeru, šumski voz i patke koje se šetaju stazom. Samo imajte na umu da staze imaju stepenice — kolica ostavite u kolima i ponesite nosiljku.
description.en: Plitvice is the region's most famous national park — turquoise lakes spilling into one another over countless waterfalls, with wooden boardwalks running just above the water. For children it's pure magic: electric boats across the lake, a forest train and ducks wandering the paths. Just note the boardwalks have steps — leave the pram in the car and bring a baby carrier.

highlights.en: The electric boat ride across the big lake

highlights.en: The Great Waterfall and cascades along the boardwalks

highlights.en: Counting ducks and fish in the clear water

pros.en: An unforgettable sight — children are spellbound by the waterfalls

pros.sr: Čist vazduh i hlada šume i leti
pros.en: Clean air and forest shade even in summer

pros.sr: Deca do 7 godina ulaze besplatno
pros.en: Children under 7 enter free

cons.en: The boardwalks have steps — not suitable for a pram

season.sr: Grad je otvoren cele godine; zoo i park Maksimir najlepši su od aprila do oktobra.
season.en: The city is open all year; the zoo and Maksimir Park are at their best from April to October.

tagline.sr: Prijatan grad sa zoološkim vrtom u starom parku i uspinjačom do Gornjeg grada.
tagline.en: A friendly city with a zoo in an old park and a funicular to the Upper Town.

description.sr: Zagreb je jedan od najprijatnijih gradova u regionu za porodice: zoološki vrt u senci starog parka Maksimir, kratka uspinjača do Gornjeg grada i ulice pune kafića gde kolica prolaze bez problema. Maksimir je sam po sebi dan provedbe — jezera, staze i igrališta, a zoo je odmah u njemu. Sve je povoljno i grad je lako obići za jedan ili dva dana.
description.en: Zagreb is one of the region's friendliest cities for families: a zoo in the shade of the old Maksimir Park, a short funicular up to the Upper Town, and streets full of cafés where a pram rolls easily. Maksimir alone is a full day — lakes, paths and playgrounds — and the zoo sits right inside it. Everything is affordable and the city is easy to cover in a day or two.

highlights.sr: Uspinjača do Gornjeg grada

highlights.en: Ban Jelačić Square and the Manduševac fountain

pros.sr: Zoo je jeftin i u hladovini — savršen za malu decu
pros.en: The zoo is cheap and shaded — perfect for small children

pros.sr: Ravan centar i tramvaji koji olakšavaju kretanje
pros.en: A flat centre and trams that make getting around easy

pros.en: Maksimir is a vast free park with lakes and playgrounds

cons.en: The city centre can get hot in summer

cons.en: The funicular is short — quicker on foot than queueing

season.sr: Aquacolors radi sezonski, otprilike od maja do septembra; plaže i šetnice su najbolje leti.
season.en: Aquacolors is seasonal, roughly May to September; the beaches and promenades are at their best in summer.

tagline.sr: Plićak, borovi i veliki vodeni park — letovanje načisto za najmlađe.
tagline.en: Shallows, pine trees and a big water park — a holiday made for the youngest.

description.sr: Poreč je jedan od najomiljenijih porodičnih gradova na Jadranu: duge šetnice uz more, plaže sa plićakom i senka borove šume odmah iza plaže. Kraljica zabave je Aquacolors, veliki vodeni park sa toboganima i dečjim zonama na nekoliko kilometara od grada. Stari grad sa Eufrazijevom bazilikom je ravan i lako se obilazi kolicima.
description.en: Poreč is one of the Adriatic's best-loved family towns: long seafront promenades, beaches with shallow water and the shade of a pine forest just behind. The star attraction is Aquacolors, a big water park with slides and kids' zones a few kilometres from town. The old town with the Euphrasian Basilica is flat and easy to cover with a pram.

highlights.en: Aquacolors — kids' zones and water slides

highlights.sr: Plaže sa plićakom i šetnje uz more
highlights.en: Shallow beaches and seaside promenades

highlights.sr: Stari grad i Eufrazijeva bazilika
highlights.en: The old town and the Euphrasian Basilica

highlights.sr: Vožnja turističkim vozom uz obalu
highlights.en: The little tourist train along the coast

pros.sr: Plićak i borova senka — bebe se mogu igrati satima
pros.en: Shallows and pine shade — babies can play for hours

pros.sr: Šetnice su ravne i bez stepenika, idealne za kolica

season.sr: Sezona kupanja traje od juna do septembra; Biokovo park i Skywalk rade od aprila do novembra.
season.en: The swimming season runs June to September; Biokovo Park and the Skywalk run April to November.

tagline.sr: Duga šetnica uz plićak, a iznad — planina sa staklenim vidikovcem.
tagline.en: A long promenade by shallow water, with a mountain and its glass viewpoint above.

description.sr: Makarska rivijera je niz mesta podno planine Biokovo, sa kilometarskim šetnicama uz more i plažama koje se blago spuštaju u vodu — idealno za malu decu. More je čisto i prozirno, a šetnica je ravna pa se s kolicima stiže svuda. Za starije i roditelje tu je Skywalk, stakleni vidikovac na Biokovu sa pogledom na ceo arhipelag.
description.en: The Makarska Riviera is a string of towns beneath Mount Biokovo, with kilometres of seafront promenades and beaches that slope gently into the water — ideal for small children. The sea is clean and clear, and the promenade is flat so a pram gets everywhere. For older kids and parents there's the Skywalk, a glass viewpoint on Biokovo looking out over the whole archipelago.

season.en: The city is open all year; the promenades and parks are at their best from April to October.

tagline.sr: Mali grad bez automobila, sa zmajevima, uspinjačom i rekom kroz sam centar.
tagline.en: A small, car-free city of dragons, a funicular and a river through its very centre.

description.sr: Ljubljana je grad po meri mališana: pešačka zona uz reku Ljubljanicu, Zmajski most sa zmajevima, i grad na brdu do kog se stiže uspinjačom koju deca obožavaju. Sve je blizu, ravno i uredno, sa igralištima i parkom Tivoli na deset minuta od centra. Grad se lako obiđe za dan i lako se kombinuje sa Bledom ili Postojnom.
description.en: Ljubljana is a city made for little ones: a pedestrian zone along the Ljubljanica, the Dragon Bridge with its dragons, and a hilltop castle reached by a funicular children love. Everything is close, flat and tidy, with playgrounds and Tivoli Park ten minutes from the centre. It's easy to see in a day and pairs well with Bled or Postojna.

tagline.sr: Vožnja podzemnim vozićem kroz najposećeniju pećinu Evrope.
tagline.en: An underground train ride through Europe's most-visited show cave.

description.sr: Postojnska jama je najposećenija pećina u Evropi, a njen glavni adut za porodice je podzemni vozić koji vas vozi kroz dvorane pune stalaktita — deca su oduševljena, a noge se ne umaraju. Obilazak traje oko sat i po, sa vodičem i šetnjom kroz najlepše dvorane. Odmah pored je Predjamski grad, srednjovekovna tvrđava ugrađena u stenu, koja izgleda kao iz bajke.
description.en: Postojna is Europe's most-visited show cave, and its big selling point for families is an underground train that carries you through halls full of stalactites — children are thrilled and little legs never tire. The tour lasts about an hour and a half, with a guide and a walk through the finest chambers. Right next door is Predjama Castle, a medieval fortress built into the rock that looks straight out of a fairy tale.
